thread:
olivia: we spun up two new AWS accounts for the pilot and both regions show zero GPU quota. accounts: 123456789012 (ap-south-1) and 210987654321 (ca-central-1). we need p5 and g5 family capacity for a small cluster plus burst nodes.

sam: OK. can you list exact instance counts and a safety margin so i can open service-quotas requests? also confirm vCPU and ENI needs.

olivia: plan: p5 family = 4 instances (primary cluster), g5 family = 6 instances (burst). request margins: p5 -> 8, g5 -> 12. networking: current ENI quota is 50, we need to support ~500 ENIs across the account because subnets will host ~200 pods per AZ. request ENI increase to 600.

alex: double-check vCPU math — p5.48xlarge is 192 vCPU per instance (approx). so 4 of those = 768 vCPU; g5.12xlarge ~48 vCPU * 6 = 288. total ~1056 vCPU. ask regional vCPU quota ~1200 to be safe. also watch ENI-per-instance limits and per-instance ENI attachments.

sam: drafting SQ and support cases now. i'll request: per-region vCPU=1200, P family desired=8, G family desired=12, Elastic Network Interfaces desired=600 for both ap-south-1 and ca-central-1.

sam: example CLI i ran: 
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 1200 --region ap-south-1
(repeated with family quota codes and ENI quota codes)

quota-bot: ticket SQ-2026-845 created (ap-south-1). ticket SQ-2026-846 created (ca-central-1).

maria: heads-up finance — this is expensive. what's the estimated monthly burn if fully utilized? need numbers before i approve any escalation.

olivia: rough on-demand costs if fully utilized: p5 ~ $30/hr * 4 * 24 * 30 ≈ $86k/month. g5 ~ $5/hr * 6 * 24 * 30 ≈ $21.6k/month. combined ~ $108k/mo upper bound. we will use spot/reserved and autoscaling to limit actual spend.

maria: i can approve emergency runway up to $60k/mo for the pilot. anything above needs explicit finance + sales signoff. tag resources with cost-center=pilot-bob and enable budget alerts.

alex: network checklist — ensure subnets have enough IPs (use /20 or /19 per AZ), check ENI attachment counts per instance type, and confirm AMI/driver compatibility for p5 (NVIDIA drivers, NVLINK). plan a small soak after quotas land.

sam: created AWS Support case #9876543210 requesting quota increases and ENI/vCPU adjustments, marked as technical urgent and attached architecture diagram + PO. link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?displayId=9876543210

aws-support: Case 9876543210 acknowledged. standard review 48-72 hours; expedite possible with business justification.

olivia: added business justification: "Enterprise pilot with signed PO. Production readiness depends on p5/g5 capacity in ap-south-1 and ca-central-1. Estimated spend attached." asked for expedite.

sam: service-quotas SQ-2026-845 (ap-south-1) moved to Case Owner Review. AWS requested launch template sample and per-family quota codes; i've uploaded a sample launch template and subnet plan.

sam: AWS asked for expected start date — set to next Monday.

maria: confirmed emergency approval up to $60k/mo. please enable budget alerts and notify finance if usage approaches 75% of that cap.

olivia: enabling cost alerts and autoscaling + spot fallback to control burn. will tag pilot resources and update billing exports.

alex: once quotas are granted, we'll run a validation: boot 1 p5 and 2 g5 nodes, validate AMI, kernel, NVLink, ENA drivers, EFA if needed, and kernel module versions.

sam: update: SQ-2026-845 moved to "Case Owner Review"; AWS Support case 9876543210 created. i've added all request IDs and console links to our internal runbook at /runbooks/cloud/quota-requests.md.

dev-oncall: @olivia please ping #eng-oncall 30m before cluster deployment window.

aws-support: Case 9876543210 — expedite approved for ap-south-1 p5/g5 vCPU and ENI increases. fulfillment expected within 24 hours.

olivia: awesome. i'll validate when quotas appear and then coordinate the deployment window with oncall. will post updates here if AWS asks for anything else. :thumbsup:
